columns.description: Foreign key to `users.id`. The user who owns this account.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: Display name for the account.

columns.name: account_type

columns.name: account_status
columns.description: Account status. Values: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `SUSPENDED`.

columns.name: features
columns.description: Feature flags and capabilities enabled for this account.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the account was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.

columns.name: profile_id
columns.description: Reference to the account's profile configuration.

columns.name: limit_level
columns.description: The transaction limit tier assigned to this account.

columns.name: client_properties
columns.description: Client-side metadata.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the account was soft-deleted by the application. Null if the account is active.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.description: Primary key. Unique transaction identifier.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `users.id`. The user who initiated the transaction.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `users_account.id`. The account the transaction belongs to.

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.description: Transaction type. Values: `COLLECTION`, `CONVERSION`, `DISBURSEMENT`, `COLLECTION_CONVERSION`, `CONVERSION_DISBURSEMENT`, `COLLECTION_CONVERSION_DISBURSEMENT`, `EARNED_REWARD`, `REVERSAL`, `INCOMING`, `INCOMING_PEER_TO_PEER`, `OUTGOING_PEER_TO_PEER`, `CONVERSION_OUTGOING_PEER_TO_PEER`, `INCOMING_COLLECTION`.

columns.name: transaction_state
columns.description: Current transaction state. Values: `CREATED`, `COLLECTION_IN_PROGRESS`, `CONVERSION_IN_PROGRESS`, `DISBURSEMENT_IN_PROGRESS`, `WORKFLOW_IN_PROGRESS`, `WAITING_ON_WORKFLOW`, `WAITING_ON_RECIPIENT_APPROVAL`, `ON_HOLD`, `PENDING_CAPTURE`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED`, `REJECTED`, `REFUNDED`, `REVERSED_TO_WALLET`, `VOIDED`.

columns.name: sent_amount
columns.description: The amount the sender sent, in `sent_currency`.

columns.name: sent_currency
columns.description: ISO currency code of the sending currency (e.g. `GBP`, `USD`, `EUR`).

columns.name: received_amount
columns.description: The amount the recipient receives, in `received_currency`.

columns.name: received_currency
columns.description: ISO currency code of the receiving currency (e.g. `KES`, `TZS`, `NGN`, `UGX`).

columns.name: exchange_rate
columns.description: The exchange rate applied to this transaction (1 unit of sent_currency = exchange_rate units of received_currency).

columns.name: source_amount
columns.description: The original amount before fees, in the sending currency.

columns.name: recipient_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `transactions_recipient.id`. The recipient of this transaction. Null for non-disbursement types.

columns.name: recipient_account_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `transactions_recipient_account.id`. The specific payment destination. Null for non-disbursement types.

columns.name: workflow_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the approval workflow, if the transaction requires one. Null for most transactions.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the transaction was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent state change.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the transaction offer expires if not completed.

columns.name: memo
columns.description: Optional note from the sender to the recipient.

columns.name: purpose
columns.description: Purpose of the remittance. Values: `REMITTANCE`, `SALARY_AND_WAGES`, `GOODS_PURCHASE`, `SERVICES_PAYMENT`, `BILLS_PAYMENT`, `P2P_TRANSFER`.

columns.description: Foreign key to `wallets.id`. The wallet the funds are collected from. Null for card-funded transactions.

columns.name: to_wallet_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `wallets.id`. The wallet the funds are disbursed to. Null for bank/mobile money payouts.

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Structured summary of the transaction. Contains nested objects: `original.source_amount.amount` (float, the pre-fee amount), `fees` (array of fee objects, each with `definition.label` and `definition.kind`).

columns.name: metadata
columns.description: Provider-specific metadata. Structure varies by payment method.

columns.name: fee_label

columns.name: fee_kind

columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent state change.

columns.name: updated_at

columns.name: provider_name
